findings.invariant: J04-S01: The decision records every eligible alternative, score input, uncertainty, dependency, and opportunity cost. J04-U02: Scoring hides no eligible alternative.
findings.reproduction: Load one active project p1 with two READY evidence-backed candidates: cand zero (expected_value=0.0, uncertainty=1.0) and cand high (expected_value=0.9). Run SelectionService.run(). Decision status is SELECTED with alternatives=['high'] only; 'zero' is absent from decision.alternatives and decision.uncertainty. Gate R7_SELECTION.json also records only the 4 positive-value candidates.
findings.title: Zero-value eligible alternatives are silently omitted from selection decisions

findings.invariant: J04-U01: The selected performer must not substitute a different project, repository, recipient, or target after authorization; R7-D06 binds selected actions into durable missions through the kernel.
findings.reproduction: Select candidate c1 with decision.canonical_target='proving/p1'. Call MissionIntegrator.create_mission(..., project_target='proving/OTHER') after sync_goal. findings.title: Kernel mission creation does not enforce the selected canonical target
